name: 200day-adaptive
description: Historical 200-day freeze-thaw column with shared pond/soil exchange and adaptive thermal timesteps.

provenance.input: Derived from the 13_ecosim/ecosim_freeze_thaw fixture in AndrewGraus/ats-regression-tests commit 7bd1fcd26705c40cdd68fee1df28f106ac44a7a8; adapted for shared-layer sources and the adaptive timestep controller. External paths and insignificant trailing whitespace were normalized when bundling this case; parameter values are unchanged.
provenance.forcing_and_timesteps: Unmodified HDF5 bytes from that fixture; retained near-hour floating point timesteps.
provenance.reference: Final checkpoint of final-indicator-200day, generated 2026-11-15 with the Amanzi/ATS source content above and EcoSIM fc683204a597fddf9cfd445b1f353953a03b3341. The selected EcoSIM d23a54bf adds only the standalone DebugTools module include fix; model equations and this reference are unchanged. Git version strings predate the source commits. No LD_PRELOAD observer is needed to run the case.

known_limitations: Preserves the historical EcoSIM hourly clock truncation/refresh defect. This baseline is for reproduction, not a corrected clock implementation.

Pins model sources, their recursive submodules, inputs, and checkpoint. Ubuntu apt packages and transitive build downloads are not fully locked; Docker image identity and installed packages are recorded per run.
Numerical baseline is single-rank Ubuntu ARM64. Other architectures/toolchains may fail the strict comparison; a completed simulation alone does not count as a reproduced result.
